traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune, Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Imagination meets power. A deep generational signature: intensified collective imagination and transformation. The trine makes this a natural strength: Heightened collective vision. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Imagination and power flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what imagination and power have realized.

shadow: The ease lets illusion and escapism and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: Sometimes understanding the deeper reason behind someone’s behavior makes you more compassionate without making the behavior any more acceptable.
readerCopy.body: Sometimes understanding the deeper reason behind someone’s behavior makes you more compassionate without making the behavior any more acceptable. When Neptune trines Pluto, emotional insight can help you see the history, fear, grief, desire, or power underneath a situation without forcing you to choose between empathy and clear judgment. Let the fuller context change your understanding, but do not use understanding as a reason to abandon the boundary the situation still requires. You can see why something happened and still decide it cannot continue.
